name: auto-archive
about: Auto-archive on the lab's own chats (16 Nov 2026, chat/auto_archive.rs; built 15 Nov in #125, until now only its e2e spec): two real chats, each made 40 days older (`age --chat same`, test mode's e2e_chat_age), then the rule set to 30 days, as Settings does — the chat not shown is archived, the one the Chat view shows is kept; the quiet notice in Yap's window and its Undo; the next run archives it again (Undo brings it back as it was); then the shown one too once another chat is shown. Any lab: on the plan the questions are Claude Code's, on --fake the fake AI's.

steps.ask: In one sentence: what is a haiku?

steps.note: Its last use moved back 40 days (only this chat: a lab's other chats stay as they are).

steps.ask: Name one colour of the rainbow. One word.

steps.note: Setting it runs it at once (as Settings does); the notice says so in Yap's window, then Undo.

result.matches: /Archived a chat you hadn't used in 30 days/

steps.note: The haiku chat archived; the colour chat, shown in Chat, kept; Undo brought it back.
The next run: the same chat again (Undo doesn't make it newer).

steps.ask: Say hello in French. One word.
steps.note: Another chat shown: the colour chat is no longer the one in view.
This one only a day older: never due.
The colour chat goes now; the new one stays (a day old, and shown).
